summary: Iter313 — End-to-end FR VTC standard ride flow (estimate → create → accept → arriving → start-OTP request/verify → completed) tested via the PUBLIC HTTP API with payment & security invariants. 9/9 new e2e backend tests pass + iter308 + iter312 regression pass. Frontend smoke: landing page booking form (Google Places autocomplete, pickup/dropoff testids) renders correctly and gates booking to /login via redirect. No 500s observed across the full lifecycle.

minor.issue: Returns 401 on the public landing page (no token) — surfaces as a console error in dev tools. Acceptable but noisy; consider not calling /me when no token is stored.

integration_issues.issue: URL is rewritten to '/' (landing page) instead of redirecting to /login?redirect=/taxi?mode=standard. The landing booking widget still works, but the request explicitly cites /taxi?mode=standard as the target route — confirm intended behavior or implement an auth-aware redirect so /taxi keeps its query string after login.

Login page (/login) exposes phone-only auth (testid='phone-input', placeholder '6 12 34 56 78'). Email/password rider accounts created via POST /api/auth/register cannot complete sign-in from the UI — only phone-login is available. If email auth for riders is intended, the UI is missing the email/password fields.

action_items: Confirm whether /taxi?mode=standard should be a distinct route or aliased to /. Currently it lands on the marketing/booking landing.
Decide on rider email/password login UI: backend /api/auth/login works for email/password but the /login screen only exposes phone-login.
(Optional) Suppress /api/auth/me 401 on the public landing when no token is stored to keep the browser console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rides.py: payment settlement flow (lines 1918-2039) correctly implements the anti-fraud invariant: digital_captured_fare = min(charge, final_fare); driver wallet credited ONLY on the captured digital amount; cash rides emit payment_status='pending_cash' with cash_due_to_driver and never credit the driver wallet. Verified end-to-end through the API.

routes/phase1.py /start-otp/verify: correctly rejects empty OTP, wrong OTP, and only allows status transitions from {accepted, arriving} → in_progress. switch_to_cash_if_needed is invoked AFTER status update — good, cash-switch flash now reaches both driver and rider.

routes/rides.py switch_to_cash_if_needed: persists original_payment_method, payment_shortfall, payment_switched_to_cash; sends WS flash to driver+rider AND persists Notification rows for both — meeting the request's real-time + persistent requirements.

routes/phase1.py /start-otp/request is mounted at /api/phase1/rides/{id}/start-otp/request (not /api/rides/...). The review request references /api/rides/{id}/start-otp/request which does NOT exist — the actual path is under /phase1. Worth aliasing or documenting.
Frontend login page only exposes phone-based auth — if a rider self-registers with email/password (which the API allows), they cannot sign in from the UI.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 new e2e + 7/7 regression on iter308 & iter312)
success_rate.frontend: smoke-only: booking form loads, autocomplete works, gates to /login

Driver wallet balance read/written only for delta assertions; demo driver flipped online via direct Mongo (status=approved, is_online=true, current location at PICKUP). Rider wallets credited via direct Mongo (the admin credit endpoint requires the admin path which is out of scope; using direct write keeps the test hermetic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter313 suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iter313_vtc_e2e.py is the full VTC-standard end-to-end API harness (book→accept→arriving→OTP→complete→settle, plus cash variants, OTP-security, /api/wallet shape, cancel, rate). It uses the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Path nuance to remember: OTP endpoints live under /api/phase1/rides/{id}/start-otp/{request,verify} — NOT /api/rides/.... rca of the issue: No bug to RCA this iteration — the previously-fixed iter309 'timedelta' shadowing is verified by /wallet/withdraw-request not returning 500 (returns 200/4xx per state). The anti-fraud invariant (driver never credited for un-captured money) is reproved end-to-end in TestE2ESwitchToCash.
